limitations: The laypersons derived their pleasure from none of the 25 building cues that were examined in this study, suggesting unmeasured cues are important for laypersons.
The two groups shared only a single physical cue (fanciness) as a basis for their arousal appraisals, implying other shared cues were not among the 25 investigated.
Complete uniformity in photographic angle and style could not be attained for the building slides.
Not all of the 59 TACS cues could be reliably rated (only 25 met criterion), and some had little variability or were unclear to raters.
